employment-meeting.method: Direct inspection of all seven16-frame contact sheets and four selected native-resolution frames. Records sheets02–05 were re-opened after a truncated tool response; the truncated output was not credited.
employment-meeting.motion: The employee slides a single opaque sheet left toward the other adult during roughly 0.17–0.75 seconds, releases it at about0.83 seconds, withdraws the moving hand and settles both hands beside the pen by about1.33 seconds. The manager keeps two clasped hands; the settled pose continues through4 seconds.
employment-meeting.limitations: Faint lines vary slightly and the moving fingers soften with motion blur. No extra hands, duplicated or translucent paper, discontinuous slide, signing or money observed.

employment-records.motion: The single landscape sheet moves right over the open folder. The left hand releases by roughly0.33 seconds and returns to the desk; the right hand keeps the lower-right edge and lowers the sheet onto the stack, settling by roughly1.3 seconds. employment-records.limitations: Fine vertical grid lines fade in the moving frames and return as the sheet settles; this is not a faithful reproduction of an authentic record. No duplicated hands, vanishing or translucent sheet, teleport or readable personal information observed.
employment-records.scope: Fictional document handling only; no authentic employment record, real client, signature, dismissal finding, wage arrears finding or severance entitlement/payment.

toolInput.prompt: One continuous fixed-camera real-time workplace meeting shot. The sage-cardigan employee on the right slides the one existing lined sheet LEFT about one sheet-width toward the manager, releases it and withdraws the touching hand to rest near the other hand and black pen. Manager hands stay clasped and stationary. Finish this one clear paper-return motion by 1.6667 seconds, then keep the end pose with tiny natural motion through4 seconds. Preserve exactly two anonymous adults, four coherent hands, the solid opaque sheet, faint lines, folder, pen, blank badge and camera. Physical continuous sliding only: no fade, dissolve, ghosting, extra paper or limbs, teleport, signing, writing, money, approval or case outcome. Do not move the camera. Fictional unsigned-paper return, not a real dismissal or legal finding.
